behavior.fingerprint_scope: Only the path argument of workspace file tools (list_files, read_file, search, write_file, patch_file) is normalized for repetition identity.
behavior.path_identity: Paths are resolved from the runtime workspace root with host-native Path semantics and normalized for host case semantics. Absolute, relative, and dotted aliases of the same resolved path therefore share a fingerprint; different resolved paths remain distinct.
behavior.runtime_wiring: Pico.repeated_tool_call passes self.root into the repetition helper. The existing tool executor order remains validate, repetition, permission, policy, execute.
behavior.containment_boundary: Fingerprint normalization makes no containment decision. Pico.path and tool validation remain the sole workspace containment owners and still execute before repetition; permission and ToolPolicy checks remain unchanged.
behavior.retry_after_read: A prior_read_required mutation retry is unlocked only by a successful same-resolved-path read whose structured tool_status is ok and whose structured tool_error_code is empty. Rendered display text is not interpreted as status.
behavior.platform_boundary: Uses existing host-native pathlib/os semantics only. No Windows-native capability was added and the Ubuntu WSL2/Python 3.12 canonical gate is unchanged.
